question: Does routing the domain-fused map through per-worker owned chunks (no pre-zeroed shared buffer) make sqrt @1M faster?
answer: NO. Producer-only timing says 2.2-2.9x FASTER; producer+consumer timing says 0.72-0.86x SLOWER. The apparent win was deferred materialization.
comparison_class: FP-vs-FP route A/B (picks a default), not a vs-incumbent row
method: ONE process, ONE ELF, ABBA-interleaved 15 rounds/arm against write-once OFF at (8,200000). The consume axis touches as_f64_slice() INSIDE the clock, forcing the chunked column's OnceLock materialization.
gate: Refused unless the A/A null median is within 2% of unity; a candidate certifies only if its CI excludes unity AND |log effect| exceeds twice the null log margin.

runs.window: load 22.57/22.69/26.77, host MHz mean 3226.8 at end
